svg.text: Limits of the Logitech M650 wheel (no Mac software can fix these)
All three recorded from the mouse itself, before mousemap or anything else on the Mac sees the events.
1. Rubbing the wheel up and down fast: the strokes back are never reported
92 notches in a row, all one way, in bursts with silent gaps: the strokes back sent nothing
The same rubbing on the trackpad: every stroke counts, the page goes up and down
2. Grabbing a free-spinning wheel to switch direction: the mouse sends nothing until it clicks the other way
mousemap turns the page at once
3. How a free spin ends: grabbed by a finger vs stopped by itself
gap between the last notches of the spin (ms)
Both end at full speed with no slowing down, so there is no way to tell a grab from a normal stop.
